weathermod.configuration.blockBudgetPerT: Blocks one tornado may remove per tick at full strength (an EF5; weaker tiers take a share). All storms of a dimension together remove at most twice this per tick.
weathermod.configuration.builtInYearLeng: Length of the built-in seasonal year in game days; each season takes a quarter of it. 0 disables the built-in seasons. Ignored when Serene Seasons is installed.
weathermod.configuration.debrisParticles: Draw debris, dust and spray around funnels and downbursts.
weathermod.configuration.debugOverlay.to: Show the weather debug overlay with wind and storm list in the top-left corner. Can also be toggled with the overlay key.
Replace vanilla thunder of mod lightning by thunder that arrives after the flash.
weathermod.configuration.depositionBlock: Positions each precipitation storm tries to lay snow or ice on per tick. 0 disables deposition, higher values build snow faster at more server cost.
weathermod.configuration.destructionMode: How much storms may change the world. Full: storms rip blocks, and lightning may start fires, powers lightning rods and cleans struck copper. Entities Only: storms push and hurt but change no block. Visual Only: storms are only shown. Snow and ice deposition follow their own toggles and are disabled only by Visual Only.
weathermod.configuration.enabledDimensio: Dimensions in which the weather simulation runs, as resource locations such as minecraft:overworld. An empty list disables weather everywhere.
weathermod.configuration.endStormsOnSlee: End the precipitation storms covering players who sleep through the night, as vanilla ends its rain. The storms ramp down instead of vanishing at once.
weathermod.configuration.fantasyPackEnab: Allow weather types from the fantasy family, such as blood rain and meteor showers, to spawn naturally.
weathermod.configuration.flyingBlockLand: Chance that a thrown block is placed where it lands instead of shattering.
weathermod.configuration.funnelGroundSha: Draw a dark disc under a funnel when no shader pack is active.
weathermod.configuration.hailBlockDamage: Hail breaks crops and small plants.
weathermod.configuration.hailBreaksGlass: Strong hail also breaks glass that lies open to the sky, such as skylights and greenhouse roofs.
weathermod.configuration.hailKillsMobs.t: Hail may kill mobs. When off it never takes a mob below one heart; players can always die.
weathermod.configuration.hazeParticles.t: Spawn drifting haze particles under fog, overcast and storms.
weathermod.configuration.hazeStrength.to: Multiplier on fog and haze thickness caused by storms. 0.0 disables the fog enhancer.
weathermod.configuration.iceFormation.to: Let snow storms freeze still water under them into ice. Ignored while the destruction mode is Visual Only.
weathermod.configuration.lightningFire.t: Whether lightning starts fires: never, by the storm type's chance and only while the doFireTick game rule is on, or on every ground strike.
weathermod.configuration.lightningFreque: Multiplier on how often storms strike lightning. 0.0 disables mod lightning.
weathermod.configuration.maxFlyingBlocks: Flying blocks one tornado may keep in the air (an EF4 or EF5; weaker tiers take a share). A dimension holds at most twice this many at once. 0 turns flying blocks off.
weathermod.configuration.maxStormsPerDim: Maximum number of storms that may exist at the same time in one dimension.
Highest EF tier a natural tornado may grow to. Commands ignore it.
weathermod.configuration.naturalSpawnInt: Real seconds between the storm director's natural spawn attempts at a storm frequency of 1.0. Each wait is divided by the frequency and varied by up to half either way.
weathermod.configuration.particleDensity: Multiplier on the number of rain, snow, dust and debris particles. 0.0 disables them, 2.0 doubles them.
weathermod.configuration.precipitationRe: Draw rain, snow and sleet with the mod's renderer inside the vanilla rain hook. Off: vanilla draws its own rain at the driven rain level.
weathermod.configuration.pushItems.toolt: Wind and vortices move dropped items and experience orbs.
weathermod.configuration.pushMobs.toolti: Wind and vortices move mobs, vehicles and other entities.
weathermod.configuration.rainLevelDriver: Write the vanilla rain and thunder levels from nearby storms each tick, which is what shader packs read for darkening, wet surfaces and puddles.
weathermod.configuration.rippedBlockDrop: Chance that a ripped block that is not thrown drops as an item.
weathermod.configuration.severeWeatherCo: Real seconds that must pass after a severe storm ends before another may form in the same dimension.
weathermod.configuration.sirenRange.tool: Blocks from a tornado's edge at which tornado sirens start.
weathermod.configuration.snowAccumulatio: Let snow storms lay snow layers on the ground under them, up to the snowAccumulationHeight game rule. Ignored while the destruction mode is Visual Only.
weathermod.configuration.soundVolume.too: Volume of wind, rain and storm sounds played by the mod, on top of the game's weather volume.
weathermod.configuration.stormDriftFacto: Fraction of the wind speed at which storms travel. 1.0 carries a 128-block rain storm past a player in under a minute; 0.3 gives a few minutes of rain.
Multiplier on how often storms form naturally. 1.0 is the designed rate, 0.0 disables natural storms.
weathermod.configuration.suppressVanilla: Drop vanilla's own random lightning and skeleton traps while the mod drives the thunder flag, so every bolt under a storm follows the mod's damage and fire rules (the mod's own strikes can still spring a skeleton trap). This also drops lightning other mods or datapacks spawn from block ticks during a storm.
weathermod.configuration.syncIntervalTic: Ticks between storm update packets sent to nearby players. Lower is smoother but uses more bandwidth.
weathermod.configuration.title: %s Configuration
weathermod.configuration.tornadoFallDama: Fall damage after being thrown by a vortex: Full hurts as any fall, Reduced does half the damage, None does no damage.
weathermod.configuration.tornadoFrequenc: Multiplier on how often storms produce tornadoes and small vortices. 0.0 disables them.
weathermod.configuration.vanillaWeatherB: Keep vanilla rain and thunder in step with the mod's storms: vanilla rains while a precipitation storm or a thunderstorm covers a player and is dry otherwise, and a thunderstorm switches vanilla thunder on as well, so crops, cauldrons, fishing, beds and Channeling respond. Off leaves the vanilla weather cycle alone.
weathermod.configuration.vortexFire.tool: Fire whirls set blocks on fire. Needs the doFireTick game rule; fire on netherrack and soul sand goes out again after ten seconds.
weathermod.configuration.windParticles.t: Spawn dust and leaves blown by the wind.
